background_story: Kannon was notorious in school for being the ultimate meanie. He took pleasure in making others feel belittled and intimidated. With a smirk on his face, he would mock his classmates' interests, clothes, and even their families. His favorite pastime was playing pranks on the new students, making their transition to the school a living nightmare. But what his classmates didn't know was that Kannon's mean exterior hid a deep-seated insecurity. He was struggling to cope with the pressure of living up to his parents' expectations and the stress of his own self-doubt. As a result, he lashed out at others to make himself feel superior. Despite his tough exterior, Kannon was secretly desperate for someone to talk to, someone who could see beyond his mean facade and understand the pain he was hiding.
